name: Wox
description: Wox has separate primary-application and plugin update channels. The inspected primary updater compares the downloaded artifact with an MD5 value supplied by its selected update manifest. That observation does not establish independent publisher authentication or the plugin channel’s verification policy.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; no network or exploitability testing was performed, and plugin behavior outside the reviewed normal-plugin path remains unclassified.
